mapper.select: WITH hnsw_config AS ( SELECT set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'relaxed_order', true), set_config('hnsw.ef_search', #{efSearch}::text, true) ), vector_search AS ( SELECT id, library_id, media_id, content, chunk_index, metadata, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding}::vector) AS rank, 1 - (embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding}::vector) AS vector_score FROM kb_chunk, hnsw_config WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} ORDER BY embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding}::vector LIMIT #{vectorTopK} ), fulltext_search AS ( SELECT id, library_id, media_id, content, chunk_index, metadata, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', content), query) DESC) AS rank, ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', content), query) AS bm25_score FROM kb_chunk, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryTerms}) query WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} AND to_tsvector('simple', content) @@ query ORDER BY bm25_score DESC LIMIT #{bm25TopK} ) SELECT COALESCE(v.id, f.id) AS id, COALESCE(v.library_id, f.library_id) AS library_id, COALESCE(v.media_id, f.media_id) AS media_id, COALESCE(v.content, f.content) AS content, COALESCE(v.chunk_index, f.chunk_index) AS chunk_index, COALESCE(v.metadata, f.metadata) AS metadata, COALESCE(v.created_at, f.created_at) AS created_at, COALESCE(v.vector_score, 0) AS vector_score, COALESCE(f.bm25_score, 0) AS bm25_score, (COALESCE(rrf_score(v.rank, #{rrfK}), 0) + COALESCE(rrf_score(f.rank, #{rrfK}), 0))::float AS rrf_score FROM vector_search v FULL OUTER JOIN fulltext_search f ON v.id = f.id ORDER BY rrf_score DESC LIMIT #{topK}
